datasets.name: RapidEye Analytic Ortho Tile multispectral image
datasets.verbatim: A RapidEye Analytic Ortho Tile multispectral image collected by the RapidEye-5 satellite on August 22nd, 2014 was used... The authors also thank the Editor-in-Chief, the Associate Editor, and the anonymous reviewers for their criticism and suggestions, which helped to improve this paper.

datasets.name: Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) digital elevation model (DEM)
datasets.verbatim: Morphological information (slope angle) was derived from a digital elevation model (DEM) from the SRTM mission (Farr et al. 2007), processed to remove outlier data, re-sampled to a 12.5 m spatial resolution, and distributed by the Alaska Satellite Facility (ASF DAAC 2020).

methods.name: Pixel-based supervised multispectral image classification (Maximum Likelihood, Random Forest, and Support Vector Machines)
methods.summary: The authors compared three pixel-based supervised classifiers (Maximum Likelihood, Random Forest, and Support Vector Machines) to identify shallow landslide scars using RapidEye multispectral imagery and SRTM-derived slope data. The classification was performed in QGIS using the SCP and Dzetsaka plugins.
methods.source: QGIS, SCP plugin, and Dzetsaka plugin
methods.verbatim: Three pixel-based supervised multispectral image classifiers were applied in QGIS 3.14 (QGIS 2020): Maximum Likelihood, using the SCP plugin (Luca 2016), and Random Forest and SVM using the Dzetsaka plugin (Karasiak 2016).
